title: Udzungwa Mountains: Rainforest Hiking and Waterfalls
excerpt: The Udzungwa Mountains are a rainforest park for hikers, with waterfalls, endemic primates and no game drives at all.
body:
Udzungwa Mountains National Park is part of the Eastern Arc Mountains, a chain of ancient forested mountains known for unique plants and animals. There are no roads inside the park: you explore it on foot.

## Sanje waterfalls

The most popular hike leads to the Sanje Falls, which drop down the mountain in several stages. You can swim in the pools. The walk takes about four to five hours return.

## Primates

Udzungwa is home to primates found nowhere else, such as the Udzungwa red colobus and the Sanje mangabey. Black-and-white colobus monkeys are also common.

## Longer hikes

Multi-day treks with camping are possible, for example to Mwanihana Peak.

## Combine

Udzungwa lies close to [Mikumi](/blog/mikumi-national-park-guide/), so it combines well with a southern safari.

## Practical

- Shoes with grip; trails can be slippery.
- Bring water and rain protection.
- A ranger or guide is required.

Read our [Udzungwa page](/national-parks/udzungwa-mountains-national-park/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
